en.headline: Red flag hoisted at Big Wave Bay Beach due to large waves
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the red flag was raised at Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District on Monday morning because of big waves, advising beachgoers not to swim.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced on Monday that a red flag had been hoisted at Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District because of large waves.
The department issued the notice at 9:33 HKT and advised beachgoers not to swim at the beach. Red flags indicate that conditions are unsuitable for swimming.
No other beaches were reported to have red flags hoisted in the same announcement. Swimmers are routinely reminded to check flags and sea conditions before entering the water.

zh.headline: 大浪灣泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康樂及文化事務署表示，因大浪於周一大浪灣泳灘懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客不要游泳。
body: 康樂及文化事務署周一公布，南區大浪灣泳灘因大浪已懸掛紅旗。
署方於上午9時33分發出通知，並勸諭泳客不要在該泳灘游泳。紅旗表示海面情況不適合游泳。
是次公布並無提及其他泳灘懸掛紅旗。泳客一向被提醒在下水前留意旗號及海況。
